verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission will reach speeds of approximately 24,500 mph (39,430 km/h) for trans-lunar injection.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The system will power the Orion spacecraft to reach a speed of about 24,500 mph.'; R3: 'translunar injection (TLI)—... Escape velocity—or the speed Artemis II will achieve...—is 24,500 miles per hour'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state 24,500 mph for TLI/escape velocity in Artemis II context.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission will re-enter Earth’s atmosphere at roughly 25,000 mph (40,000 km/h) to test the heat shield.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: '25,000 mph: Speed during Earth reentry'; R3: 'reentry speed of 25,000'; R4: '40,000 kph (25,000 mph)'; R5: '40,233km per hour (25,000 miles per hour)'; R8: 'test the capsule's heat shield during reentry'
verifications.reasoning: References consistently cite ~25,000 mph (or equivalent km/h) for reentry; heat shield test explicitly supported.

verifications.claim: The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket lifts off with 8.8 million pounds of thrust.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: '8.8 million pounds: Thrust at liftoff'; R3: '8.8 million lb. of thrust'; R7: '8.8 million pounds (4 million kilograms) of thrust'; R9: '8.8 million pound of thrust'
verifications.reasoning: Exact figure repeatedly stated for SLS liftoff thrust.

verifications.claim: The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket reaches speeds over 17,000 mph shortly after launch.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'the rocket goes soaring off into space at approximately 17,000 mph'; R3: 'Speeding along at 17,500 miles per hour'; R9: '17,000 mph'
verifications.reasoning: References confirm SLS reaches ~17,000-17,500 mph post-launch/boosters.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission's launch/injection speed is ~24,500 mph (about Mach 33) to escape Earth's gravity.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'reach a speed of about 24,500 mph'; R3: 'Escape velocity... 24,500 miles per hour'
verifications.reasoning: Speed exactly matches for injection/escape; Mach 33 is approximate (24,500 mph ≈ Mach 32), not contradicted.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission's reentry speed is ~25,000 mph (40,233 km/h) upon returning from the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: '40,000 kph (25,000 mph)'; R5: '40,233km per hour (25,000 miles per hour)'
verifications.reasoning: Exact figures match reentry speed from lunar return.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II capsule will be slowed to roughly 17 mph for final splashdown in the Pacific.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'settle... at a gentle 15 mph'; R4: 'slow... to 17mph for splashdown in the Pacific Ocean'
verifications.reasoning: Sources cite 15-17 mph for Pacific splashdown; 'roughly' accommodates minor variance.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission travels over 1.4 million miles total.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2: '685,000 miles: Total journey'; R3: '685,000 of them'; R6: 'Distance travelled 700,237 mi'
verifications.reasoning: References specify total distance ~700,000 miles, directly contradicting >1.4 million.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission takes the crew around the moon and back over a 10-day mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '10-day crewed test mission... taking a lap'; R2: '10-day journey around the moon'; R3: '10-day journey around the far side'; etc.
verifications.reasoning: All references confirm 10-day mission looping around Moon without landing.
